lens: isolated fault recovery, evidence authority and transport provenance
scope: internal iOS source and Simulator read workflows

resolved_findings.finding: A present observation timestamp hid unavailable evidence authority in Today.
resolved_findings.correction: Primary and continuation summaries prioritize evidence availability.
resolved_findings.proof: Native same-proposal unavailable/restored comparison; mobile test-matrix counterexample.

resolved_findings.finding: Large Dynamic Type compressed fault controls and truncated labels.
resolved_findings.correction: Vertical actions, expandable details, full text layout and explicit targets.
resolved_findings.proof: Chinese AX5 failure, background recovery and close journey.

resolved_findings.finding: Bare trace milliseconds could be mistaken for request duration.
resolved_findings.correction: Mark request-start offsets with an explicit relative-time prefix.

limits: The transport and wire data are synthetic; server authentication/rate limiting/model streams are not exercised.
Expiry uses an injected monotonic clock in the unit check, not a five-minute device wait.
No physical-device, older-OS, small-device or full assistive-technology certification.
No TestFlight, deployment or hosted CI execution.
